sources.title: Unramified degree three invariants of reductive groups

sources.inspected: Introduction, Proposition 4.1, Corollary 6.3, Proposition 7.1 and its proof, Theorems 8.4 and 11.3, and Example 11.2.

sources.title: Unramified degree three invariants for reductive groups of type A
sources.inspected: Introduction, Theorem 1.2 and characteristic/coefficients conventions; proof section checked for central-quotient scope.

sources.title: Degree three invariants for semisimple groups of types B, C, and D
sources.version: arXiv v4, 25 April 2019; Advances in Mathematics 351 (2019), 195-235
sources.inspected: Introduction and explicit alternatives and characteristic-zero hypothesis in Theorem 1.2; selected invariant and residue discussion.

sources.title: Degree 3 unramified cohomology of classifying spaces for exceptional groups
sources.version: Inspected arXiv v1, 5 June 2019; author publication list confirms Journal of Pure and Applied Algebra 225 (2021), no. 10, 106718. Final publisher PDF not inspected.
sources.inspected: Introduction, Theorem 1.1, Proposition 2.2, Corollary 4.3, Section 5 including Lemma 5.2 and Theorem 5.4. Relevant proofs were checked, not merely the abstract.

sources.title: A rational construction of Lie algebras of type E7
sources.version: arXiv v2, submitted 3 July 2015; downloaded PDF title page internally dated 25 January 2020. Journal of Algebra 481 (2017), 348-361. No claim of final-PDF identity.
sources.inspected: Section 3, subgroup and odd-degree surjectivity Theorem 1, its proof and the central diagram. Numbering differs from B21 reference to Proposition 1.

sources.title: Une liste de problemes

sources.inspected: Printed page 15, Problems 7.7-7.8 and discussion of known vanishing families. Problem 7.8 asks a different base-extension question; it is not treated as proof of current openness of this target.
